name: Oxytocin
used_for: Oxytocin is a nine amino acid peptide hormone. The FDA-approved product (Pitocin, injection) is labeled for hospital use in labor induction and stimulation, adjunct management of incomplete abortion, and control of postpartum bleeding. Compounded nasal sprays, sublingual troches and creams are marketed online for mood, bonding, stress and sexual function, but these uses are not FDA-approved, and randomized trials of the nasal route in autism and alcohol use disorder have not shown clear benefit.

entries.text: Label: Pitocin (oxytocin injection) for labor induction or stimulation is given only by intravenous infusion, with an initial dose of 0.5 to 1 milliunit per minute, increased in increments of 1 to 2 milliunits per minute at 30 to 60 minute intervals until the desired contraction pattern is reached.
entries.population: Pregnant adults for medically indicated induction or stimulation of labor

entries.text: Label: Pitocin for control of postpartum uterine bleeding is described as 10 units given intramuscularly after delivery of the placenta, or 10 to 40 units added to an intravenous infusion running (maximum 40 units to 1000 mL).
entries.population: Adults after delivery with postpartum uterine bleeding

entries.text: Label: Pitocin for incomplete, inevitable, or elective abortion is described as an intravenous infusion of 10 units in 500 mL of physiologic saline or 5% dextrose-in-water after curettage.
entries.population: Adults with incomplete, inevitable, or elective abortion

internet_entries.text: A peptide education website (SeekPeptides) says intranasal oxytocin is commonly cited at 24 IU (about 40 mcg) as three sprays per nostril, 10 to 20 IU for anxiety or mood uses, and 24 to 32 IU for sexual enhancement. The site promotes its own membership service.
internet_entries.population: As described by the source, not a study population

administration_guidance.text: The Pitocin label states the product is for intravenous infusion or intramuscular injection, that for induction or augmentation of labor it is to be given only by the intravenous route under adequate medical supervision in a hospital, and that patients receiving intravenous oxytocin need continuous observation by trained personnel.
administration_guidance.label: research

administration_guidance.text: The Pitocin label states uterine response begins almost immediately after intravenous administration and subsides within about 1 hour, and begins within 3 to 5 minutes after intramuscular injection and lasts 2 to 3 hours; plasma half-life is about 1 to 6 minutes.
administration_guidance.label: research

administration_guidance.text: The Pitocin label states the vials are stored at controlled room temperature (20 to 25 C).
administration_guidance.label: research

administration_guidance.text: A placebo-controlled trial of intranasal oxytocin in children and adolescents with autism gave it intranasally every day over 24 weeks and reported adverse events similar between the oxytocin and placebo groups.
administration_guidance.label: research

administration_guidance.text: Wikipedia's oxytocin medication article says oxytocin can be given by injection or as an intranasal spray used in psychiatric and endocrine contexts, that nasal oxytocin is thought to reach the brain along the olfactory nerve, and that sublingual absorption is poor.
administration_guidance.label: internet

administration_guidance.text: A blogger with affiliate links says he favors sublingual or nasal oxytocin, advises using it around specific romantic occasions rather than every day because of its short half-life, and says it can make a person feel bonded to whoever is present at the time.
administration_guidance.label: internet

side_effects.text: The Pitocin label lists maternal adverse reactions including anaphylaxis, cardiac arrhythmia, hypertensive episodes, nausea, vomiting, postpartum hemorrhage, uterine rupture and subarachnoid hemorrhage, and states that severe water intoxication with convulsions and coma, and maternal death from water intoxication, have been reported.
side_effects.label: research

side_effects.text: The Pitocin label lists neonatal reactions including bradycardia, low Apgar scores, neonatal jaundice, retinal hemorrhage, seizures and fetal death, and states it is not indicated for elective induction of labor.
side_effects.label: research

side_effects.text: In the 24-week intranasal oxytocin trial in children with autism, the authors reported the incidence and severity of adverse events was similar in the oxytocin and placebo groups.
side_effects.label: research

side_effects.text: In a 12-week placebo-controlled trial of intranasal oxytocin in people with alcohol use disorder, the authors reported the treatment was well tolerated with mild adverse events comparable across groups.
side_effects.label: research

side_effects.text: A 2019 systematic review of 15 randomized trials of intranasal oxytocin in anxiety and depression (Clinical Psychopharmacology and Neuroscience) reported that in the studies that tracked adverse reactions, jitteriness, nervousness, dry mouth and drowsiness occurred about equally with oxytocin and placebo.
side_effects.label: internet

internet_claims.claim: Alzforum's page on intranasal oxytocin says it has been studied for frontotemporal dementia, autism, schizophrenia and PTSD, and that in an early dementia trial about one third of treated patients showed more inappropriate sexual behavior.
Wikipedia says intranasal oxytocin shows potential in autism, anxiety disorders and PTSD but that the evidence is limited, and that it may improve recognition of positive social cues.
A 2019 systematic review of 15 randomized trials concluded that evidence for intranasal oxytocin in anxiety and depression remains inconclusive, with most studies using a single administration.

A Substack author with affiliate links promotes exogenous oxytocin for bonding, sexual desire and intimacy while acknowledging trials show it does not beat placebo for sexual quality, and passes on an anecdote of depersonalization.

research.summary: FDA DailyMed prescribing information for Pitocin (oxytocin injection, USP), Par Health, revised May 2026.
research.finding: Indicated for medically indicated induction or stimulation of labor, adjunct therapy in incomplete or inevitable abortion, and control of postpartum bleeding; not for elective induction; intravenous use in a hospital for labor.

research.summary: 24-week randomized placebo-controlled phase 2 trial of intranasal oxytocin in 290 children and adolescents aged 3 to 17 with autism spectrum disorder.
research.finding: No difference from placebo on the primary social withdrawal measure (difference -0.2, 95% CI -1.5 to 1.0); secondary outcomes generally did not differ; adverse events were similar in both groups.

research.summary: 12-week randomized double-blind placebo-controlled multisite trial of intranasal oxytocin in 100 people with alcohol use disorder.
research.finding: No significant difference in percent heavy drinking days during maintenance; lower anger and aggression scores with oxytocin; well tolerated with mild adverse events.

research.summary: Systematic review of 15 randomized controlled trials of intranasal oxytocin in anxiety and depressive disorders (De Cagna, Fusar-Poli, Damiani et al., Clinical Psychopharmacology and Neuroscience).
research.finding: Mostly single-dose studies (13 of 15) with no significant effects on core symptoms; the authors concluded evidence is inconclusive and called for larger trials with long-term dosing.

research.summary: Placebo-controlled study of intranasal oxytocin on food intake and metabolism in healthy men, tested fasted with intake measured 45 minutes after dosing (Ott, Finlayson, Lehnert et al., Diabetes).
research.finding: Oxytocin cut chocolate cookie intake by 25%, lowered stress hormone levels and curbed the meal-related rise in blood glucose; hunger-driven intake was unchanged.

research.summary: Study of 89 prairie voles given intranasal oxytocin or saline daily from weaning (day 21) to sexual maturity (day 42) (Bales et al., Biological Psychiatry).
research.finding: Low-dose developmental treatment led to a long-term deficit in partner preference in male voles after treatment stopped.

dose.summary: The label covers hospital use only: an intravenous drip starting at 0.5 to 1 milliunit per minute for labor, or 10 units into a muscle after delivery for bleeding. Nasal studies in autism and alcohol use disorder used about 24 to 70 international units (IU) a day, and online sources describe 20 to 50 IU doses that no label covers.

items.text: Defy Medical, a telehealth company, says oxytocin troches (dissolving tablets held in the cheek) are suggested at 25 to 50 IU once daily to increase desire, with an extra 25 IU 20 to 30 minutes before sex. The company sells peptide therapies.
items.label: internet

items.text: Empower Pharmacy, a compounding pharmacy that sells it, lists its oxytocin nasal spray as 1 to 2 sprays in each nostril once daily, with the prescriber free to choose other doses. The page says the product has not been evaluated by the FDA.
items.label: internet

timing.summary: The label says intravenous effects begin almost at once and fade within about 1 hour, and intramuscular effects begin in 3 to 5 minutes and last 2 to 3 hours. Online sources describe nasal doses in the morning, before social events, or troches at bedtime, none of which has been tested.

items.text: The Pitocin label states uterine response begins almost immediately after intravenous administration and subsides within about 1 hour, and begins within 3 to 5 minutes after intramuscular injection and lasts 2 to 3 hours; plasma half-life is about 1 to 6 minutes.
items.label: research

items.text: In a study of healthy men, intranasal oxytocin was given and food intake was measured 45 minutes later (Ott et al., Diabetes 2013).
items.label: research

items.text: Wikipedia's oxytocin medication article says intranasal oxytocin has a central duration of at least 2.25 hours and as long as 4 hours.
items.label: internet

items.text: Peptide Protocol Wiki, which links to outside suppliers, says morning or early afternoon is preferred for research protocols and that nasal doses are given 30 to 45 minutes before behavioral assessments or therapy sessions.
items.label: internet

items.text: The Peptide Guides, a site that links to a vendor directory, says no time of day is required, that daily users can dose in the morning to match social interactions, and that effects begin 30 to 45 minutes after a dose and last 2 to 4 hours.
items.label: internet

items.text: Defy Medical, a telehealth company that sells peptide therapies, recommends oxytocin troches at bedtime because of possible orthostatic hypotension (a drop in blood pressure on standing).
items.label: internet

fasting.summary: The label has no food rule, but it warns about water intoxication when oxytocin runs continuously and the patient is also drinking fluids. A small study in healthy fasted men found nasal oxytocin cut snack intake and blunted the glucose rise after a meal. No online source found gives a food rule.

items.text: The Pitocin label states oxytocin has an intrinsic antidiuretic effect that increases water reabsorption, so water intoxication should be considered, particularly when it is given continuously by infusion and the patient is receiving fluids by mouth.
items.label: research

items.text: In healthy men tested fasted, intranasal oxytocin cut chocolate cookie intake by 25%, lowered stress hormone levels and curbed the meal-related rise in blood glucose (Ott et al., Diabetes 2013). Hunger-driven food intake was not affected.
items.label: research

frequency.summary: The label describes a hospital drip adjusted every 30 to 60 minutes, or a single intramuscular dose after delivery, and gives no missed-dose rule. Nasal trials ranged from daily dosing to a single dose, and most trials in one review gave only one dose. Online sources suggest once or twice daily or as needed.

items.text: Label: for labor, the infusion rate is raised every 30 to 60 minutes until the desired contraction pattern is reached, and the infusion can be stopped abruptly if contractions become too strong. For postpartum bleeding, 10 units is given once intramuscularly after delivery of the placenta.
items.label: research

items.text: A placebo-controlled trial of intranasal oxytocin in children and adolescents with autism gave it every day over 24 weeks and reported adverse events similar between the oxytocin and placebo groups.
items.label: research

items.text: In a 2019 systematic review of 15 randomized trials of intranasal oxytocin in anxiety and depression, 13 studied only a single dose. One anxiety trial used 24 IU once a week for 4 weeks, and one depression study used 16 IU once daily for 12 weeks.
items.label: research

items.text: Alzforum says dementia trials used a single 24 IU dose, then 24, 48 or 72 IU twice daily for one week, then 72 IU given daily, every other day, or every third day for six weeks.
items.label: internet

items.label: internet

items.text: The Peptide Guides, a site that links to a vendor directory, describes as-needed use 1 to 3 times a week before specific situations, or once daily.

items.text: Peptide Protocol Wiki, which links to outside suppliers, says nasal doses are used once or twice daily for research protocols, or as a single dose before therapy sessions.

cycle_length.summary: The longest human trial found ran 24 weeks in autism and found no benefit over placebo. A vole study of daily nasal oxytocin for three weeks found impaired pair bonding later, but this is animal data. Online sources describe 2 to 4 weeks on and 2 weeks off, with no study behind it.

items.text: In the 24-week autism trial, intranasal oxytocin did not beat placebo on social withdrawal. A 12-week alcohol use disorder trial found no significant difference in heavy drinking days, with a small numerically larger reduction in weeks 9 to 12.
items.label: research

items.text: In young prairie voles given intranasal oxytocin daily from weaning through sexual maturity (about 3 weeks, 89 animals), low doses led to a deficit in pair bonding after treatment stopped. The authors say long-term treatment may differ from short-term results and that safe chronic use needs further animal study.
items.label: research

items.text: Alzforum says in a 2009 to 2010 pilot of 20 people with frontotemporal dementia, improvement in neuropsychiatric scores 8 hours after a dose had disappeared by one week.
items.label: internet

items.text: The Peptide Guides, a site that links to a vendor directory, says oxytocin cycles are 2 to 4 weeks on and 2 weeks off, with a conservative option of 2 weeks on and 2 off, or no cycle for as-needed use.
items.label: internet

items.text: Peptide Protocol Wiki, which links to outside suppliers, says nasal protocols run 4 to 24 weeks in clinical research, or as a single dose for acute social studies.
items.label: internet

storage_and_handling.summary: The label says store the injection vials at 20 to 25 C (room temperature). Online sellers refrigerate their compounded nasal sprays at 2 to 8 C, and one wiki says injectable oxytocin is refrigerated, which differs from the label.

items.text: The Pitocin label states the vials are stored at controlled room temperature (20 to 25 C).
items.label: research

items.text: The Pitocin label states the standard infusion is made by adding one 10 unit vial to 1000 mL of 0.9% sodium chloride or Ringer's lactate, and that parenteral products should be inspected for particles and discoloration before use.
items.label: research

mechanism.summary: Oxytocin acts on receptors in the uterus to raise calcium inside muscle cells and make it contract. In the brain, nasal oxytocin is thought to travel along the smell nerve, though the exact route in people is not settled.

items.text: The Pitocin label states oxytocin promotes uterine contractions by increasing intracellular calcium, that the number of its receptors in the uterus rises greatly in pregnancy, and that even in pure form it has pressor (blood pressure raising) and antidiuretic properties at large doses.
items.label: research

items.text: Wikipedia's oxytocin medication article says nasal oxytocin is thought to reach the brain along the olfactory nerve.
items.label: internet

best_documented_effect.summary: The label supports hospital use of injected oxytocin for labor, incomplete abortion and postpartum bleeding. For the nasal route, the large trials in autism and alcohol use disorder found no clear benefit over placebo, and a review of anxiety and depression trials called the evidence inconclusive.

items.text: The Pitocin label lists indications of medically indicated labor induction, stimulation of labor, adjunct therapy in incomplete or inevitable abortion, and control of postpartum bleeding. It states Pitocin is not indicated for elective induction of labor.
items.label: research

items.text: In a 290-participant trial in autism, the change in the social withdrawal score was -3.7 with oxytocin and -3.5 with placebo (difference -0.2, 95% CI -1.5 to 1.0).
items.label: research

items.text: In a 100-participant alcohol use disorder trial, heavy drinking days did not differ significantly between oxytocin and placebo, though anger and physical aggression scores were lower with oxytocin.
items.label: research

items.text: A 2019 systematic review of 15 randomized trials found no significant effects on core symptoms of anxiety or depression and called the evidence inconclusive, noting most studies used a single dose.
items.label: research

items.text: Wikipedia says intranasal oxytocin shows potential in autism, anxiety disorders and post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) but that the evidence is limited, and that it may improve recognition of positive social cues.
items.label: internet

items.text: Alzforum says intranasal oxytocin is under investigation for frontotemporal dementia, autism, schizophrenia, pain, substance use disorders, obesity, personality disorders and PTSD.
items.label: internet

items.text: A Substack author with affiliate links promotes exogenous oxytocin for bonding, sexual desire and intimacy while acknowledging trials show it does not beat placebo for sexual quality.

side_effect_groups.title: Labeled (hospital use)
side_effect_groups.summary: The label lists serious maternal and newborn reactions from intravenous use in labor, including water intoxication, rupture of the uterus and heart rhythm problems.

items.text: The Pitocin label lists maternal adverse reactions including anaphylaxis, cardiac arrhythmia, hypertensive episodes, nausea, vomiting, postpartum hemorrhage, uterine rupture and subarachnoid hemorrhage, and states that severe water intoxication with convulsions and coma, and maternal death from water intoxication, have been reported.
items.label: research

items.text: The Pitocin label lists neonatal reactions including bradycardia, low Apgar scores, neonatal jaundice, retinal hemorrhage, seizures and fetal death, and states it is not indicated for elective induction of labor.
items.label: research

side_effect_groups.title: In trials
side_effect_groups.summary: Nasal oxytocin trials reported side effects about as common as placebo, but one dementia study saw more inappropriate sexual behavior.

items.text: In the 24-week intranasal oxytocin trial in children with autism, the authors reported the incidence and severity of adverse events was similar in the oxytocin and placebo groups.
items.label: research

items.text: In a 12-week placebo-controlled trial of intranasal oxytocin in people with alcohol use disorder, the authors reported the treatment was well tolerated with mild adverse events comparable across groups. The most common event in both groups was reduced sense of smell (hyposmia).
items.label: research

items.text: A 2019 systematic review of 15 randomized trials of intranasal oxytocin in anxiety and depression reported that in the anxiety studies 37% of participants had adverse events, mainly jitteriness, nervousness, dry mouth and drowsiness, with no difference between oxytocin and placebo.
items.label: research

items.text: Alzforum says that in an early dementia safety study (24 to 72 IU twice daily for one week), about one third of treated patients showed more inappropriate sexual behavior.
items.label: internet

side_effect_groups.title: Online reports
side_effect_groups.summary: Sellers list lightheadedness, headache, drowsiness and nasal irritation. Bloggers mention bonding with whoever is present and one case of depersonalization.

items.text: Defy Medical, a telehealth company that sells peptide therapies, lists lightheadedness, vertigo, drowsiness, dry throat or mouth, abdominal pain, anxiousness, euphoria, calmness and headache as side effects.
items.label: internet

items.text: Empower Pharmacy, a compounding pharmacy that sells it, lists transient nasal burning, runny nose, headache and mild nausea as common, and dizziness, palpitations or flushing as infrequent.
items.label: internet

items.text: A blogger with affiliate links says oxytocin can make a person feel bonded to whoever is present at the time.
